metadataRaw.title: How to Crack Your Back Between Your Shoulder Blades
metadataRaw.description:
Does your back feel locked up and tight between the shoulder blades and it just feels like it needs to be released with a pop or crack? 

In this video, Dr. Rowe shows you how to safely crack your back between your shoulder blades for INSTANT RELIEF. 

He goes over THREE WAYS to self adjust your upper and middle back to hit that spot around the scapula, or shoulder bones. 

That way you'll be able to release pressure in the back QUICKLY, and get the pop or crack you're looking for. They can be done at home or work, pretty much ANYPLACE and ANYTIME!

Watch now and take one step towards better health!
